item.name: Noob
item.cardSummary: Free starter Survivalist built around consumables. Bloxy Cola clears slows and adds speed, Slateskin Potion trades mobility for temporary overhealth, and Ghostburger grants a short undetectable or invisible window to break chase.

item.name: 007n7
item.cardSummary: Stealth Survivalist who misdirects the killer with clones. Dex helps track the farthest survivor spawn, Clone drops a decoy while you go hard to read, Inject steers the clone, and c00lgui teleports you to a distant spawn after a risky channel.

item.name: Veeronica
item.abilities: Vandalism, SK8, SK8 - Trick, Broadcast, Activate Battery
item.cardSummary: Robot Survivalist with skateboard mobility and self-heal only. Metal Frame blocks external healing, Vandalism paints graffiti paths for SK8, tricks restore stamina and battery, Broadcast changes collision modes, and Activate Battery converts charge into HP.

item.name: Shedletsky
item.cardSummary: Free Sentinel with a prediction sword stun and self-heal. Slash is the main stun tool and punishes misses, while Fried Chicken restores health when you create space. Simple kit with high timing skill ceiling.

item.name: Guest 1337
item.cardSummary: Frontline Sentinel built to take hits for the team. Made to Last raises base HP to 110, Self Sacrifice gives him hit priority over other entities, Block absorbs attacks, Charge knocks the killer, and Punch converts defense into stuns.

item.name: Two Time
item.typeNote: Also listed as Survivalist on some character pages
item.cardSummary: Fragile Sentinel who earns a second life through Oblation. Sacrificial Dagger deals damage to build that meter, Crouch supports stealth movement, and Ritual places a respawn beacon so a charged rebirth can bring you back with reduced health and an escape window.

item.name: Chance
item.abilities: Coin Flip, One Shot, Reroll, Hat Fix
item.cardSummary: RNG Sentinel whose max health and tools change every round. Unpredictable Fate randomizes starting health, Coin Flip can recharge abilities or stack weakness, One Shot is an unreliable stun gun, Reroll reshuffles stats, and Hat Fix resets a bad string of tails.

item.name: Jane Doe
item.passives: Till Death Do Us Part, Digital Footprint, Shatterpoint
item.cardSummary: Quest-unlocked hybrid who tracks the killer and converts setup into long stuns. Digital Footprint shows killer trail marks, Shatterpoint is a separate damage-reduced health pool restored by landing abilities, Crystal Pitch builds Resonance, and Hatchet stuns harder as Resonance stacks climb.

item.name: Elliot
item.cardSummary: Free starter Support medic. Order Up! boosts healing as you complete objectives, Deliverer's Resolve reveals critically hurt teammates, Pizza Throw is the main heal projectile, and Rush Hour turns pizza picks into a short speed boost for escapes.

item.name: Builderman
item.cardSummary: Area-control Support who builds map tools. Sentry Construction places a turret that slows the killer, and Dispenser Construction creates a healing zone for teammates. Strong when you set up early and defend your buildings.

item.name: Dusekkar
item.cardSummary: High-difficulty Support who shields allies and controls tempo from range. Levitation quiets footsteps, Spawn Protection channels a resistance shield onto a targeted teammate, and Plasma Beam slows killers or speeds survivors depending on who it hits.

item.name: Taph
item.cardSummary: Low-difficulty trap Support. Tripwire slows the killer and reveals their aura when crossed, and Subspace Tripmine is a placement bomb that punishes killers who walk into its range. Placement and sightline control matter more than raw aim.
